nicknames: Home of the Mornington & Peninsula Cups

main_turf.surface: Turf (Rye and Kikuyu grass on free-draining sandy Peninsula loam)
main_turf.stretch_length: 210 metres — steeply uphill to the winning post
main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). Operated by the Melbourne Racing Club (MRC). A highly distinctive, undulating 1,800m circuit featuring a fast downhill sweeping run from the 600m mark into the home corner, followed immediately by a sharp turn and a notoriously short 210-metre steep uphill home straight. Pure tearaway leaders ('E') who burn energy downhill often stall on the uphill rise, while deep backmarkers ('C') run out of straight. Agile on-pace stalkers ('P') holding momentum around the home turn dominate.
main_turf.post_bias: STRONG INSIDE-TO-MIDDLE BARRIER BIAS: Barriers 1 through 5 are major advantages over 1000m, 1200m, and 1500m. Looping the field 4-wide on the downhill cambered turn into a 210m straight is virtually impossible, especially when the portable rail is Out 5m to 8m.

handicapping_angles.downhill_turn_uphill_210m_horses_for_cou: Mornington's downhill-turn-to-uphill-210m-finish geometry is unique in Victoria. Horses that stay balanced cornering downhill and corner tightly carry an enormous venue-specialist advantage (+3.5 pts for prior Mornington winners).
handicapping_angles.peninsula_cup_and_mornington_cup_metro_c: Hosts marquee MRC feature cards including Peninsula Cup Day (November Spring Carnival) and Mornington Cup Day (Autumn Saturday Metropolitan card granting Caulfield Cup ballot exemption). Feature fields reach full Melbourne Metro Benchmark 78-100 / Listed quality (+3.5 pts class angle).
handicapping_angles.local_peninsula_and_cranbourne_stable_ed: Mornington and neighboring Cranbourne/Balnarring trainers (Matt Laurie, Anthony & Sam Freedman, Cliff Brown, Shane Nichols, Jerome Hunter, Ciaron Maher, Gavin Bedggood) target home-peninsula cards heavily (+2.5 pts).
handicapping_angles.rail_out_momentum_lock: Monitor MRC portable rail positions (True vs Out 3m/6m/8m). When the rail is Out 5m+, ground-saving leaders ('E') and box-seat stalkers ('P') cornering on the fence hold a decisive advantage.
handicapping_angles.melbourne_metro_class_droppers: Runners dropping from Caulfield, Sandown, or Moonee Valley midweek/Saturday metro races hold a clear speed-figure edge over country-grade rivals, provided they possess tactical gate speed.

par_adjustment.tier: Tier 2 (Victorian Premier MRC Provincial / Metro Venue)
